pr.title: Complete managed Blazor WebAssembly debugging in VS Code
pr.author: adamint

failed_jobs.name: Tests / No-package tests (regular, Aspire.Cli.Tests, Cli, Cli, tests/Aspire.Cli.Tests/Aspire.Cli.Tests.cs... / Cli (macos-latest)
failed_jobs.reason: Test failure is Aspire.Cli.Tests.Commands.SdkDumpCommandTests.SdkDumpCi_ForHostingProject_DoesNotEmitWarnings failing because a remote-executed dotnet build of Aspire.Hosting.csproj emitted unexpected warnings (Expected: 0, Actual: 6). The PR only modifies VS Code extension files, not Aspire.Cli or Aspire.Hosting code, and this matches a known recurring flaky-test cause with 6 prior occurrences.

failed_jobs.name: Tests / Run VS Code extension E2E tests / VS Code extension E2E (Windows, browser-debugger)
failed_jobs.reason: The PR directly adds and modifies browser debugging functionality (extension/src/debugger/languages/browser.ts, extension/src/debugger/browserDebugSessionTermination.ts, extension/src/test-e2e/browserDebugger.e2e.test.ts) and this job runs the 'browser-debugger' E2E shard which specifically exercises that new code. Job logs were unavailable, but the direct correspondence between the PR's changes and the failing shard's subject matter indicates the failure stems from the PR's changes rather than an unrelated flaky shard.

failed_jobs.name: Tests / Run VS Code extension E2E tests / VS Code extension E2E (Linux, browser-debugger)
failed_jobs.reason: Same reasoning as the Windows browser-debugger shard: the PR adds new browser debugging session termination logic and a dedicated browserDebugger.e2e.test.ts test file, and this Linux shard exercises exactly that code path. This is the second of two platform legs failing on the same PR-introduced feature, strengthening the code-issue classification.
